thread:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up: owners + short timelines for vendor/dependency mitigations (cloud auth surges + model-registry instability).

maya: Goal: ship two hotfixes this week, schedule a cross-team drill next sprint, and track recurring-pattern gating for SLA review.

alex: I can own cloud-fallback automation (feature-flagged shim, cross-region routing + retry/circuit-breaker). Dry-run by Fri EOD.

jordan: I'll own model-registry fixes: auth TTL rotation, clearer 4xx/5xx split in logs, and a 15s synthetic canary. PR by Tue.

anika: Alerts and runbook updates are mine. I'll add fallback-rate panels and pager thresholds; merge alerts Thu.

liam: I'll coordinate the failover drill: simulate primary auth region failure, verify pinned-cache behavior, and validate console degraded state. Propose Wed week-after-next.

maya: Action rows I'll create now: A1 cloud fallback (alex) - dry-run Fri, merge next Tue; A2 registry TTL + canary (jordan) - PR Tue, canary Thu; A3 alerts+runbook (anika) - Thu; A4 failover drill (liam) - plan Mon, drill Wed; A5 temp retry bump (maya) - 500ms->2s backoff during detected spikes.

maya: Instrumentation we need: auth 429/5xx per-minute, registry queue depth & smoothed 5xx rate, cross-region fallback success-rate, and upstream-provider-id in registry logs for correlation.

alex: For A1: retry-first (3x small backoff) then fallback to secondary region; circuit-breaker reset after 5m. I'll track fallback_rate metric and add alert if >1%/5m.

anika: I'll add that alert and a dashboard tile. Also agree to weekly 15m "vendor-surge" sync in incidents for 6 weeks.

jordan: Logging change will include provider_id and request_id. Will post canary config in tracker.

liam: I'll draft drill checklist and post in tracker by Mon. Include rollback and post-drill retro owner.

deploy-bot: IncidentBot: runbook "vendor-fallbacks" updated by anika - https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vendor-fallbacks :white_check_mark:

maya: Closing loop: owners set (alex A1, jordan A2, anika A3, liam A4, maya A5). If auth spikes >2 times in 2w -> escalate vendor SLA review. Tracker link coming in-channel.
